verdict.rationale: Spline documents reusable components whose instances update automatically when the main component changes, but only within a scene. A 'Team Library' appears only as a single line on the pricing page, with no description of how it publishes components or styles across files or projects. Missing for 10: documented cross-file/cross-project publishing of components and styles, shared styles, controlled update review/acceptance when the source changes, and independent corroboration.
